note: Port locals' barks (authored, not LLM), read by src/systems/npc/townsfolk.gd. The keys the guard brain asks for (contact, hit, reload, lost, give_up) plus the locals' own alarm, man_down and downed. A line is picked at random per key. Generic, in-world, no franchise terms.

alarm: They're shooting at us! Get them!
Everyone, out! They hit one of ours!
found_body: Oh no. Somebody's dead over here!
give_up: Let them run. We'll remember the face.
Back to it. Keep your eyes open.
downed: Drag them to the pit. Let the Remnant have them.

club_talk.note: Issue #392: the rave's patrons talk as you pass. Calm, when you walk within locals_say_m metres of one of the 'who' (a soldier profile), the nearest says one line from the club's style ('rave'), at most one line every locals_say_every_s seconds for the whole room (the first after locals_say_first_s). Like the beast's lines (PlanetBeast).
rave: This DJ doesn't stop. Third night running.
Grab a drink before the drop, the bar gets mobbed.
They turned the dome lights down for this one. Love it.
You can feel the bass in the rock out here.
Whatever's in the blue ones, I want another.
Somebody said the laser droid's got a mind of its own.
First time on the moon? Nobody sleeps under the dome.
Mind the floor, it bites when the beat hits.
The stalls by the wall do glow sticks. Get one.
I came for one song. That was hours ago.
Bar's long enough now you can actually get served.
Best air on the whole rock is in here, and it's all smoke.
